hero.heading: Transforming Healthcare Through Intelligent Data
hero.subheading: Srimae was founded on a simple belief: every patient deserves the full power of medical knowledge applied to their care.

story.heading: Why We Built Srimae
paragraphs: Healthcare generates enormous amounts of data — but most of it goes underutilized. Doctors are overwhelmed, time is scarce, and critical patterns that span multiple specialties often go undetected until it's too late.

Srimae was created to change that. By combining advanced AI with deep clinical domain knowledge, we give healthcare professionals the tools to see further, act faster, and deliver better outcomes for every patient they serve.

Our platform is built by a team of clinicians, data scientists, and engineers who understand both the complexity of medicine and the power of modern AI — and are committed to making that power accessible to every doctor, in every domain.
